about_the_game:
Forgebound is a medieval fantasy survival game that challenges you to rise from the ashes of a fallen world. In a land scarred by war and darkness, you must gather resources, craft essential gear, build fortified settlements, and lead your people in reclaiming lost territories.

Survival is only the beginning — manage your supplies, expand your kingdom, and defend against hostile forces. Forge powerful tools, unlock new technologies, and build alliances as you carve out a future in a harsh and unforgiving world.

Key Features:

  • Survival Mechanics: Manage hunger, thirst, health, and morale to keep your people alive.

  • Resource Gathering and Crafting: Harvest resources and craft weapons, armor, tools, and supplies.

  • Base Building: Design and construct fortified settlements to protect against enemies and the elements.

  • Dynamic World: Face changing weather, seasons, and random world events.

  • Combat and Defense: Battle hostile factions and defend your lands using tactics, traps, and siege equipment.

  • Faction Management: Recruit, manage, and command survivors and mercenaries to expand your influence.

  • Technology Tree: Research new advancements to unlock better gear, structures, buildings and abilities.

  • Rich Single-Player Campaign: A story-driven journey with meaningful choices and consequences.

  • Online Multiplayer Mode: Team up with friends and compete against other players. Build, survive, and wage war together or against each other in a custom shared world.

Your decisions will determine the fate of your people. Will you forge a lasting legacy, or be lost to the void?

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains depictions of medieval fantasy combat, including sword fights, use of melee weapons, and visible character deaths. Players will experience scenes of battle where mercenaries and soldiers are injured or killed. Blood and combat damage are shown, but there are no graphic dismemberments, sexual content, or depictions of drug use.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 (Intel Only if not optimized for Apple Silicon)
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Integrated Apple GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 5500M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Built-in or external sound card
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS 13.0 Ventura or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro/M2 or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: pple M1 Pro/M2 GPU or AMD Radeon Pro 6600M
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 20 GB available space
  • Sound Card: High-quality external sound card recommended

short_description: Forgebound is a medieval survival game where you must build, craft, and conquer to survive. Lead your people through a harsh, war-torn world — gather resources, construct settlements, defend against enemy forces, and forge your path to power in a land on the brink of collapse.
